title: VADER backend with coding-domain lexicon overrides
description: Add an offline VADER sentiment classifier (vader-sentiment npm package or equivalent offline port) producing a per-message compound score (-1..+1) and pos/neu/neg label, run on the same code/quote/paste-stripped text the counter already uses. Apply a documented coding-domain lexicon override so technical usage of kill, error, fail, bug, crash, abort, exception (and similar) does not count as negative. Done when: unit tests cover scoring, label thresholds, overrides, and stripped-text input; no network imports under src/sentiment.
